scripts.text:
This rock contains unidentified minerals.

scripts.translation:
這塊岩石含有未確認礦石。
無法開採超過上限的數量。

scripts.text: Nothing was caught.
scripts.translation: 沒有抓到任何東西。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
scripts.translation: 魚在水裡遊動。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
請稍等！！
您的物品欄已滿。
無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Outsider?
Outsiders have been coming more frequently.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
外來者？
最近外來者來的越來越頻繁了。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
It seems like our superiors have permitted your entrance, so I won't stop you either.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
看來上級已經允許你進入了，那我也不會阻攔你。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
My name is Arc.
By the way, hmm... Can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我的名字是阿克。
順便問一下，嗯...你能聽懂我在說什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Shake my head
scripts.translation: 搖頭

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Did you just say 'Yes'?
Can't believe we understand eachother!
When did you learn our language?
What is your race called?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什麼？你剛才說“是”嗎？
真不敢相信我們能互相理解！
你是什麼時候學會我們語言的？
你們種族叫什麼名字？

scripts.text: - I show my ring to Arc and explain everything including how I ended up here... -
scripts.translation: - 我向阿克展示我的戒指，並解釋了包括我如何來到這裡在內的一切... -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
So...hmm, That's how it is...
The source of that huge shock and mysterious explosion...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
原來如此...嗯，事情是這樣的...
那個巨大的衝擊和神秘的爆炸的源頭...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Quite an interesting story.
That's why you humans were exploring here and there...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真是有趣的故事。
原來你們人類一直在到處探索...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Now I clearly understand that you are not sent by the giants of Manuk.
Thank you for telling me these interesting stories.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
現在我很清楚，你不是馬努克巨人派來的。
謝謝你告訴我這些有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Oh? Is that so?
We use different languages as expected...
That's a bit frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
哦？是嗎？
果然我們使用的語言不同...
這有點令人沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
By the way, you...
No, never mind...
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
順便問一下，你...
不，算了...
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, right. {0}!
That's a strange pronunciation.
I might mispronunce it, so please understand...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，對了。{0}！
這個發音有點奇怪。
我可能會讀錯，請多包涵...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
總之，我有件事想拜託你。可以嗎？

scripts.text: What favor?
scripts.translation: 什麼忙？

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 現在不行。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Um...Ah..It's...
A little...complicated...
- Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克環顧四周，確認周圍沒有其他人。滿意地確認只有你之後，他壓低聲音繼續講述他的故事。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
老實說，我很擔心我的一個朋友。她未經許可就離開了，說要去檢視你們的營地。從那以後她就一直沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
但是，我不能離開崗位去找她，因為我有職責守衛存放在這裡的實驗資料。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
因為她未經許可離開，我甚至不能向上級報告...那樣只會引發更大的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
想到這些我就很擔心...
事實上，我們正在儘量避免與馬努克的巨人接觸，所以我們各自遠離對方的領地。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你們的營地正好位於作為我們兩個種族之間中立區的區域...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果她靠近了他們那邊，她可能已經進入了雪原...
那樣我們尋找她就會更加困難...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
馬努克的巨人可能會誤解這是挑釁...不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...重點就是，你想讓我去找你的朋友。對吧？
因為你自己無法在這些複雜的情況下行動？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Exactly!
You're quite observant.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
沒錯！
你很敏銳。

scripts.text: Sure, I will do it.
scripts.translation: 當然，我會去做的。

scripts.text: Sorry, can't help you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，幫不了你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，如果我要去找她，我需要更多的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You don't have to worry about that...
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
不用擔心...
^4d4dff泰拉^000000有個習慣，會用植物打結來標記目的地。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She does it so that she won't get lost.
If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她這樣做是為了防止迷路。
如果你發現一串打結的植物，順著它們應該就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It can be hard to look for them, but it's better than doing nothing...
Please, I beg of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
雖然找起來可能很困難，但總比什麼都不做強...
拜託了，求求你了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, and please keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，還有，請對其他拉菲涅斯保密。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Remember {0}... you must keep this to yourself...
Please, find her.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
記住{0}...這件事必須保密...
拜託了，找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It sure was an unreasonable favor...
You too were sent here to carry on a mission...
That was thoughtless of me...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
這確實是個過分的要求...
你也是被派來執行任務的...
是我考慮不周了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Is that so? Of course.
You were sent here to carry on your own mission...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
是嗎？當然。
你也是被派來執行自己的任務的...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
Keep that in mind when searching for her. And don't tell any other Laphine's about her missing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
^4d4dff泰拉^000000有個習慣，會用植物打結來標記目的地。
尋找她時請留意這一點。另外，不要告訴其他拉菲涅斯她失蹤的事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You {0} are the only one I could ask for help...
Do me this favor please.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}，你是唯一能幫我的人...
請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Did you find anything?
Have you found any knotted plants?
Yeah, that's the mark
that Terra leaves.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你找到什麼了嗎？
有沒有發現打結的植物？
對，那就是
泰拉留下的標記。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Keep it up and find her
for me.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
繼續找下去，
替我找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, Well met!
What do I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，幸會！
我現在該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text: What? What happened?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: - Arc looks like he was thrown into confusion about something. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克看起來陷入了某種困惑之中。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra came back!!!
but, she was covered all over with wounds...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉回來了！！！
但是，她渾身都是傷...

scripts.text: Covered with wounds?
scripts.translation: 渾身是傷？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She didn't even get treatment!
She just took the Bradium with that exhausted body!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她甚至沒有接受治療！
就帶著那副疲憊的身體拿走了魔力之石！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Didn't even tell me the reason!
I told her no, but she wouldn't listen to me!
It happened all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
連理由都沒告訴我！
我明明拒絕了，但她不聽我的！
事情發生得太突然了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!
What shoud I do now?
What do I have to do?
Terra left again and she was hurt...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}！
我現在該怎麼辦？
我該怎麼做？
泰拉又離開了，而且她受傷了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
And I just stood here...doing nothing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
而我只是站在這裡...什麼也沒做。

scripts.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility.
scripts.translation: 你有強烈的責任感。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
......anyways.
I couldn't either stop her, or follow her...
What now...?
Why did she take the Bradium...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
......總之。
我既沒能攔住她，也沒能跟上她...
現在該怎麼辦...？
她為什麼要拿走魔力之石...？

scripts.text: - You tell Arc about the Giant from the cave. -
scripts.translation: - 你告訴阿克關於洞穴裡的巨人。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Is that what happened?
Bradium...is certainly a precious ore for Sapha.
They use a refined Bradium ore...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什麼？是那樣嗎？
魔力之石...確實是薩法珍視的礦石。
他們使用精煉魔力之石...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You said that a Sapha was hurt?
And its body was already stiff?
Impossible!
Terra!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你說有一隻薩法受傷了？
而且它的身體已經僵硬了？
不可能！
泰拉！！

scripts.text: - Arc suddenly began gathering up his gear. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克突然開始收拾裝備。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Where was that cave where you found that Sapha?
There was no such cave when we inspected our surrounding areas.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你發現那隻薩法的洞穴在哪裡？
我們巡視周邊區域時，並沒有這樣的洞穴。

scripts.text: What are you trying to do?
scripts.translation: 你想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Can't you see?
I'm going out to look for Terra. She took the Bradium with her, it has got to be something to do with that Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你沒看出來嗎？
我要出去找泰拉。她帶走了魔力之石，這肯定和那隻薩法有關。

scripts.text: Is it okay for you to leave your post?
scripts.translation: 你擅離職守沒關係嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It's.. ...
...No....
Shit, then what should I do!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
這... ...
...不行....
該死，那我該怎麼辦！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will go. I'm the one who knows exactly where that cave is.
I will go and bring her back.
If Terra headed for that cave, I should be able to find her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去吧。只有我知道那個洞穴的確切位置。
我會去把她帶回來。
如果泰拉去了那個洞穴，我應該能找到她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's hear rest of the story from Terra.
It is important for you to guard this place, isn't it?
If Terra really took the Bradium without any permission...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我們聽聽泰拉剩下的故事吧。
對你來說，守衛這裡很重要，不是嗎？
如果泰拉真的未經許可就拿走了魔力之石...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The higher ups won't just remain still...
I'm sorry to ask you but...
Please go and bring her back here...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
上級不會坐視不管的...
抱歉麻煩你了，但是...
請去把她帶回來...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I'm really sorry for getting you into this mess.....
...Please, find Terra.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真的很抱歉把你捲進這堆麻煩裡.....
......請，找到泰拉。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? A wounded Laphine in the Sapha's village?
Was it Terra?! Was she captured by those Sapha bastards?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什麼？薩法的村莊裡有一隻受傷的拉菲尼？
是泰拉嗎？！她被那些薩法混蛋抓住了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I couldn't check out exactly who the captured Laphine was.
And they seem to have no intention of harming the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點。我無法確切確認被抓住的拉菲尼是誰。
而且他們似乎沒有傷害拉菲尼的意圖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Also, they were looking for something that can cure a wounded Laphine...
If we bring some medicine to them, we might have a chance to see who the Laphine is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另外，他們在尋找能治療受傷拉菲尼的東西...
如果我們給他們帶些藥，也許就有機會看到那隻拉菲尼是誰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand how anxious you feel.. but that is the only way I can think of finding out who it is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我理解你的焦急...但這是我唯一能想到的確認身份的方法。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會帶上一些治療傷口的東西。如果被抓的拉菲尼是泰拉，我會把她帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
..........
OK, that seems like the best thing we can do for this situation...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
......
好吧，看來這是目前我們能做的最好的事了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Do you by any chance know about the 'Yggdrasil'?
There's nothing better than the Yggdrasilberry to treat wounds...
Especially for us Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你聽說過“世界樹”嗎？
沒有什麼比世界樹漿果更適合治療傷口了...
尤其是對於我們拉菲尼來說...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If you have a Yggdrasilberry, you can use it to cure that Laphine...
.Yggdrasil is the tree of life... its roots are in touch with everything in this world.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果你有一枚世界樹漿果，可以用它來治療那隻拉菲尼...
世界樹是生命之樹...它的根系與這個世界的一切相連。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I have...
...only three Yggdrasilberries...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我這裡有...
...只有三枚世界樹漿果...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I will give you these but they won't be enough...
Outside... there is a huge tree... where the root of the Yggdrasil is exposed.... it should be there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我會把這些給你，但數量不夠...
外面...有一棵巨樹...那裡露出了世界樹的根系.... 應該就在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Sometimes you can find Yggdrasilberries around there.
Go find few more and bring them with you. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
有時候你可以在那裡附近找到世界樹漿果。
去多找幾枚帶在身上。快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
There's a huge root of the tree near a swamp at the outskirts of this area.
That's where the tree of life's root is exposed.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
在這片區域邊緣的沼澤附近，有一根巨大的樹根。
那就是生命之樹根系暴露的地方。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You should be able to find some Yggdrasilberries there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你應該能在那裡找到一些世界樹漿果。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You will need at least 6~7 of them...
.... .. I hope she is safe..
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你至少需要6到7枚...
.... .. 希望她平安無事..

scripts.text:
[Arc]
As soon as you are done collecting the berries, bring them to the Sapha Village right away!!!
Terra... please be safe.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
採完漿果後，立刻把它們帶到薩法的村莊!!!
泰拉...請一定要平安。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
...Oh where is Terra...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
...泰拉在哪裡...？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!!
Terra's back!!!
She is back in one piece!
...She hasn't been saying a single word since her return, I told her to rest in Yai...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}!!
泰拉回來了!!!
她完好無損地回來了！
...她回來後一直一言不發，我讓她在雅伊休息了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Please come by if you don't mind...
Terra's Yai.
Which is her Private Residence... It's located at the Southeast direction from here.
I would like to hear a detailed account of what happened.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果不介意的話，請過來一趟...
泰拉的雅伊。
那是她的私人住所...位於這裡的東南方向。
我想聽聽事情經過的詳細描述。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What happened....while she was gone?
I would like to hear a detailed account fn what happened...
Please go to Terra's Yai later.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她不在的時候...發生了什麼？
我想聽聽事情經過的詳細描述...
請稍後去泰拉的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I really appreciate what you've done for us.
But, I'm worried about Terra.
I hope she can be her old self...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我非常感激你為我們所做的一切。
但我擔心泰拉。
希望她能恢復從前的樣子...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah~Ah~Stop right there...
This area is off-limits to unauthorized personnel.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊~啊~站住...
此區域禁止未經授權的人員進入。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Yur,Dur AnoVa?
Wha? Dieb OsaDur .. 
ah..RuffThus NeAsh. man nesAsh OdesAlah ?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
Yur,Dur AnoVa?
Wha? Dieb OsaDur .. 
ah..RuffThus NeAsh. man nesAsh OdesAlah ?

scripts.text: - I can't understand what he's saying... Oh god how frustrating. -
scripts.translation: - 我聽不懂他在說什麼... 天哪，真讓人沮喪。 -

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
NeiVil !
narNoth nesMush.
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
NeiVil !
narNoth nesMush.
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!

scripts.text: - We don't seem to understand eachother. -
scripts.translation: - 看來我們彼此都不理解對方。 -

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Halt.
This area is restricted unless you have been given permission.
Especially to outsiders like you.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
站住。
除非獲得許可，否則禁止進入此區域。
尤其是像你這樣的外來者。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Tal-!
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
Agoltas Me...
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
Tal-!
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
Agoltas Me...

scripts.text: - Looks like we don't understand each other. This could be troublesome... -
scripts.translation: - 看來我們彼此都不理解對方。這可能會很麻煩... -

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
這裡很容易找到雜草...
仔細觀察，發現有一根打結的莖...
看起來這是阿克告訴我的泰拉的痕跡。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing toward the^4d4dff Southern^000000 direction.
scripts.translation: 打結的葉片指向^4d4dff南方^000000。

scripts.text:
This is a marking Terra left to remember the way back home.
A knotted leaf is pointing^4d4dff South^000000.
scripts.translation:
這是泰拉留下的標記，用來記住回家的路。
打結的葉片指向^4d4dff南方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
這裡很容易找到雜草...
沒什麼特別的地方。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
這裡很容易找到雜草...
仔細觀察，發現有一根打結的莖...
看起來這是阿克告訴我的泰拉的痕跡。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing ^4d4dff East^000000.
scripts.translation: 打結的葉片指向^4d4dff東方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
這裡很容易找到雜草...
沒什麼特別的地方。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
這裡很容易找到雜草...
仔細觀察，發現有一根打結的莖...
看起來這是阿克告訴我的泰拉的痕跡。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing ^4d4dff North^000000.
scripts.translation: 打結的葉片指向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
這裡很容易找到雜草...
沒什麼特別的地方。

scripts.text:
There are footprints here as well as signs that someone has fallen.
It looks like someone was fighting here?
But who?
scripts.translation:
這裡有腳印，還有有人摔倒的痕跡。
看起來有人在這裡戰鬥過？
但是是誰呢？

scripts.text: There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation: 有腳印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text:
Someone must have had a fight here.
There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation:
有人一定在這裡戰鬥過。
有腳印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 這裡的腳印似乎通向某個地方。

scripts.text:
There's evidence that there was a fight here too.
These footsteps can't be a Laphine's...
scripts.translation:
這裡也有戰鬥過的證據。
這些腳印不像是拉芬留下的......

scripts.text: There are footprints that lead to^4d4dff the Root of a huge tree^000000.
scripts.translation: 有腳印通向^4d4dff巨樹的根部^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints that lead to^4d4dff the Root of a huge tree^000000.
scripts.translation: 有腳印通向^4d4dff巨樹的根部^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 這裡的腳印似乎通向某個地方。

scripts.text:
There's a stem entangled inside an opening in the roots of a huge tree...
It looks like something slipped here.
scripts.translation:
在巨樹根部的縫隙裡有一根糾纏的莖...
看起來有什麼東西掉進來了。

scripts.text: A cold breeze is blowing out from deep inside the tree.
scripts.translation: 一股冷風從樹的深處吹出來。

scripts.text: Follow the trace.
scripts.translation: 追蹤痕跡

scripts.text: Looks dangerous... head back.
scripts.translation: 看起來很危險... 回去吧

scripts.text: You take a one step forward carefully through the muddy roots and slip.
scripts.translation: 你小心翼翼地穿過泥濘的樹根，卻滑了一跤。

scripts.text:
It's too dark to see anything inside...but it feels like there's a big hole at the bottom.
I'd better step back...It looks dangerous.
scripts.translation:
裡面太黑了，什麼都看不見...但感覺底部有個大洞。
還是退回去吧...看起來很危險。

scripts.text: Between huge roots, there is a hole leads to the underground cave.
scripts.translation: 巨大的樹根之間，有一個通向地下洞穴的洞口。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 進去看看

scripts.text: I'm not going in there.
scripts.translation: 我不進去

scripts.text: Again, you slip through the muddy roots.
scripts.translation: 你又一次在泥濘的樹根間滑倒了。

scripts.text: You decide to come back later.
scripts.translation: 你決定稍後再來。

scripts.text:
Strange looking stems are entangled inside an opening of huge roots.
Surface looks unstable...I should step away before I slip on it.
scripts.translation:
巨大的樹根縫隙裡糾纏著形狀奇怪的莖。
表面看起來很不穩定...我最好退開，免得滑倒。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
請稍等！！
您的物品欄已滿。
無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text: This is the only spot where sunlight is shining down through a hole in the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 這是唯一有陽光透過天花板洞口照射進來的地方。

scripts.text: Looking up I see the roots of the tree and stems digging up a mud-plastered wall, so the sunlight could shine through....2.j...There is a statue of Giant on the ground.
scripts.translation: 抬頭望去，只見樹根和莖蔓穿透了泥牆，陽光才得以透進來...2.j...地上有一尊巨人的雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A statue in a place like this...
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在這種地方竟然有一尊雕像...
真是有趣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm, This resembles... that giant tribe in Manuk...
Huh? It's wearing a muffler...
...It can't be!
scripts.translation:

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它身上有很多傷疤...看起來像是經歷過一場惡戰...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And it appears like it's holding something in its arms...
Just what happened here?

[{0}]

這裡到底發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't imagine what happened here, but I don't see Terra's marks anymore...
and this cave looks unsafe... I'd better go back to Arc for now.

[{0}]

而且這個洞穴看起來很危險...我先回去找阿克吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Could it be... Terra was fighting this Giant?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道說...泰拉在和這個巨人戰鬥？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways... How do I get out of here?
That hole I came in is too slippery to climb back out...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不管怎樣...我怎麼出去呢？
我進來的那個洞太滑了，爬不回去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Light is coming in from the ceiling above... Maybe I should just climb a stem around here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天花板上方有光透進來...也許我可以爬一下附近的莖蔓...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm done with this place.
I should go back to Arc...
Let's find an exit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受夠了這個地方。
我得回去找阿克...
找找出口吧。

scripts.text:
I came back here, but there's no trace of Terra...

scripts.translation:
我又回到了這裡，但沒有泰拉的蹤跡...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...Terra was here.....
Powdered Bradium...
What was she trying to do with this Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...泰拉來過這裡.....
粉末狀的魔力之石...
她拿著薩法想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't just go back to Arc without anything... he'd be so disappointed...
Hmm, Should I go to the Sapha's village?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什麼證據都沒帶回去...阿克肯定會很失望...
嗯，我要不要去薩法的村莊看看？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't find any traces of Terra anymore.
One thing that bugs me is...These particles of an ore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我再也找不到泰拉的蹤跡了。
讓我在意的是...這些礦石微粒。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should go back to Arc and ask about it, or go to Sapha's Village and investigate some more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我應該回去找阿克問問，或者去薩法的村莊進一步調查。

看起來它已經死了...

What should I bring with me?

scripts.text: Muffler
scripts.translation: 圍巾

scripts.text: Pants

scripts.translation: 魔力之石碎片

Ogen!!!!!!

scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
這...比...我想像的還要糟糕.....
奧根...這看起來無法逆轉了...

No matter how much bradium fluid we inject... Ogen can't come back alive...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
無論我們注入多少魔力之石...奧根都無法復活了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... really was adament... about protecting that Laphine... to protect Terra.....
He did his best 'til the last...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
奧根...真的非常執著...為了保護拉菲娜...為了保護泰拉.....
直到最後一刻...他都盡力了...

Look at this, {0}...

protected Terra...like this.

看看這個，{0}...

Ogen... made himself an unbreakable shield...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
奧根...把自己變成了一面堅不可摧的盾牌...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]

This statue will be a monument to your courage...
scripts.translation:

奧根...現在你可以回到母親的懷抱了...
這座雕像將成為你勇氣的紀念碑...

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I guess you are right...
There's... sunlight shining here...
This... must be a comfort resting place for Ogen.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]

這...一定是奧根安息的地方。

[Snorren]

I will go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]

我先走了。

樹幹伸向天花板上的一個洞。
粗大的荊棘可以作為落腳點。

scripts.text: Climb up.

而且...？什麼？你怎麼能聽懂我在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Helloo...?
Can you understand the words coming out of my mouth?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你好...？
你能聽懂我嘴裡說出的話嗎？

scripts.text: - I show the ring to Snorren. -
scripts.translation: - 我向斯諾倫展示戒指。 -

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Aha! Now I understand...
That's amazing. a ring capable of interpreting between different languages... and you were able to come all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
啊哈！現在我明白了...
這太神奇了。一枚能在不同語言間進行翻譯的戒指...而且你竟然能一路來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I heard there are outsiders helping our people.
You must be one of them!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我聽說有外來者在幫助我們的族人。
你一定是其中之一！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
But where did you hear about that Fairy?
Frankly, I want to have a word with that Fairy.
But I don't understand their language.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
但你是從哪裡聽說那個妖精的？
說實話，我想和那個妖精談談。
但我聽不懂她們的語言。

scripts.text: Why do you want to talk to her?
scripts.translation: 你想和她談什麼？

scripts.text: Do you need an interpreter?
scripts.translation: 你需要翻譯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
An interpreter? Certainly!
But I can't just do it arbitrarily...
The reason why I want to have a word with that fairy, I mean Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
翻譯？當然需要！
但我不能隨便就去做...
我想和那個妖精，也就是拉芬妮談談的原因...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I... want to find out if she's got anything to do with my friend...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我...想知道她是否和我的朋友...有關...

scripts.text: Your friend?
scripts.translation: 你的朋友？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah. Ogen is missing.
He said he was curious about the area you are living in and went to check it out. How foolish of him.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
是的。奧根失蹤了。
他說對你居住的地區很好奇，就跑去查看了一下。真是愚蠢透頂。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
And he never came back.
After quite a while, that fairy came.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
然後他就再也沒有回來。
過了很久之後，那個妖精出現了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I don't know what guts she had to just fly into our territory.
That fairy just kept on yelling 'a bradium!' 'a bradium!'
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我不知道她哪來的膽子，竟然直接飛進我們的領地。
那個妖精一直在那喊“魔力之石！”“魔力之石！”

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Our village's vigilantes are saying that fairy is affected by the power of bradium and went crazy.
That's what Laphine are all like!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我們村莊的義警們說那個妖精被魔力之石的力量影響而發瘋了。
拉芬妮她們都是這樣的！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
They just try to make accesories out of the ore which is our source of life.
They collect anything that possesses magical power.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
她們只是想用這種作為我們生命源泉的礦石製作飾品。
她們會收集任何擁有魔力的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should calm down a bit... Tell me about that captured Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你應該冷靜一點...告訴我關於那個被捕獲的拉芬妮的事。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Right, I'm sorry.
Anyways, shortly after Ogen went missing the fairy appears... this is too suspicious...
and that fairy was severely wounded too.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
好的，對不起。
總之，就在奧根失蹤後不久，那個妖精就出現了...這太可疑了...
而且那個妖精也受了重傷。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I think...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我想...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
That fairy attacked Ogen as he was trying to peek on your camp.
And she was drawn by Ogen's bradium and came all the way here to find more bradium!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
那個妖精是在奧根試圖窺探你們營地時襲擊了他的。
她被奧根身上的魔力之石吸引，一路追到這裡來尋找更多的魔力之石！

scripts.text: That could be right...
scripts.translation: 也許是這樣...

scripts.text: I don't see it that way...
scripts.translation: 我不這麼認為...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But does that Ore called bradium really possess an overwhelming magical power?
It didn't seem like that...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是那種被稱為魔力之石的礦石，真的擁有壓倒性的魔力嗎？
看起來並不像那樣...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really? But, we Sapha can't live without bradium.
This war with the Laphine... is to protect the bradium from them...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
真的嗎？但是，我們薩法人離不開魔力之石。
這場與拉芬妮的戰爭...就是為了保護魔力之石不被她們奪走...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see...
Your people and their people are fighting over the bradium...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了...
你們的人和她們的人正在為魔力之石而戰...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is... Is that so?
Then how do you see this situation?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
是...是這樣嗎？
那你如何看待這種局勢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It just occurred to me...
It's like some kind of forbidden area...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我突然想到...
這就像某種禁區...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyhow, You are going to ask that fairy about Ogen, right?
If that's the case, I could interpret between you two...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，你要去問那個妖精關於奧根的事，對吧？
如果是這樣，我可以幫你們翻譯...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah?!
Then just wait here for a sec!
I will go and ask Luik about this!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
真的嗎？！
那你先在這裡等一下！
我去問問盧伊克這件事！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh, Ah~!
This is a prison.
You need to obey the rules to keep a peaceful group life.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
呃，啊~！
這裡是監獄。
你需要遵守規則，才能維持和平的集體生活。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This is where people who break the rules are kept overnight.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
這裡是關押違反規則的人過夜的地方。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Oh. I'm not one of them.
I just have some business here.
Snorren is a good Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
哦，我不屬於他們。
我只是來這裡辦點事。
斯諾倫是個好薩法人。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Umm.. Hold on a sec...
Luik. It's me. Snorren.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
嗯...等一下...
盧伊克，是我，斯諾倫。

scripts.text:
[Voice through the door]
Ah, I told you it's not possible Snorren!
I can only put you in a cell for one night!
scripts.translation:
[門後傳來的聲音]
啊，我告訴過你不可能，斯諾倫！
我只能讓你在一個牢房裡待一晚！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yikes-! Luik, It's not that!
I brought someone who would interpret that fairy's words!
till, Can't I come in?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
哎呀-！盧伊克，不是那樣的！
我帶了一個能翻譯那個妖精話語的人來！
那麼，我不能進去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Shut up! Anyway, we have more things to worry about. This Laphine, we need to treat her wounds...
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克的聲音]
閉嘴！總之，我們有更多事情要擔心。這個拉芬妮，我們需要治療她的傷口...

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Her body is completely different from ours. What should we do?
Hey, Snorren! Bring me anything. Anything like herbs!
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克的聲音]
她的身體構造和我們完全不同。我們該怎麼辦？
嘿，斯諾倫！給我帶點東西來。任何像草藥的東西！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Herbs? Is her condition that bad?
Can't we fix her with bradium?
Oh right, She's not Sapha, ey?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
草藥？她的情況那麼嚴重嗎？
我們不能用魔力之石治好嗎？
哦對了，她不是薩法人，對吧？

scripts.text: Nothing gets past you...
scripts.translation: 什麼都瞞不過你...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Do you have anything on your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你有什麼心事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She's a Laphine, right? Then we should ask a Laphine about it...
Like what we need to treat her...
I can take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她是拉芬妮，對吧？那我們應該問問拉芬妮...
比如我們需要用什麼來治療她...
我可以去辦。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really?
Then hurry up and bring something back...
We will wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
真的嗎？
那就快點帶點東西回來...
我們會在這裡等著。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I think I have no choice but to go back and ask Arc....)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我想我別無選擇，只能回去問問阿克了....）

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Hurry up and go find a way to cure this Laphine...
Then Luik might let us in.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
快點想辦法治好這個拉芬妮...
那樣盧伊克可能就會讓我們進去了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Did you find a cure?
This.. is one strange looking fruit.
I saw this fruit from time to time, but never thought this would be a cure..?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你找到解藥了嗎？
這...是一種看起來很奇怪的水果。
我時不時會看到這種水果，但沒想到它會是解藥..？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I will take everything you've brought with you!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我會收下你帶來的所有東西！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Now, Let's go inside!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
現在，我們進去吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...this won't be enough....
I would need at least 6~7 of these...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...這還不夠....
我至少需要6~7個這樣的...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Ah, I think we would need more than what I've brought here... I'll be back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？哦，我想我帶來的這些還不夠...我馬上回來。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I already told Luik everything about you...
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我已經把關於你的一切告訴盧伊克了...
我們進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I've been waiting for you...
Let's make haste.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我一直在等你...
我們快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I'm really confused now...Should I believe your story or not.
If it is true that cave really exists and Ogen is hurt...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我現在真的很困惑...我該不該相信你的話。
如果那個洞穴真的存在，而且奧根受傷了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
The approximate location is...
Huge Roots of a tree. Got it.
You go ahead first. I will stop by at a refinery and be right after you.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
大概的位置是...
巨大的樹根。明白了。
你先走，我去一趟精煉廠，馬上就到。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Since that place is Laphine's territory, I will go quitely so they won't notice me.
You just go on ahead, I will be right behind you.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
既然那個地方是拉芬妮的領地，我會悄悄過去，以免被它們發現。
你先走，我馬上就到。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
You are back. .. Luik wanted me to tell you this...
Terra, that Laphine, is free now.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你回來了...盧伊克讓我告訴你...
泰拉，那個拉芬妮，現在自由了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
We are tired of fighting. We didn't even want to start...
And we saw her true intention before everything else.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我們厭倦了戰鬥。我們甚至不想開始...
而且在一切發生之前，我們就看到了她的真實意圖。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Go and check if Terra went back to her home safely...
Ogen... He went back to Mother Nature.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
去確認一下泰拉是否安全回到了家...
奧根...他迴歸了大自然。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I really don't think what Ogen did was the right thing to do...
But that was... Ogen...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我真的不覺得奧根做的是對的...
但那是...奧根...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Forgive me, I'm a bit depressed...
I'd rather just rest here.
I really appreciate what you've done.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
請原諒，我有點消沉...
我只想在這裡休息一下。
非常感謝您所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Come back anytime...
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
隨時歡迎回來...
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
What do you think of this muffler?
This belonged to Ogen...
Does it look good on me?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你覺得這條圍巾怎麼樣？
這是奧根的...
我戴著好看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Outsiders shouldn't be here without permission.
Please get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
外人沒有許可不能來這裡。
請離開。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ids ad?
Ns ai dha si asd!
Ms dfaa sd a.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
Ids ad?
Ns ai dha si asd!
Ms dfaa sd a.

scripts.text: The doors are locked... I can't get in.
scripts.translation: 門鎖住了...我進不去。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
請稍等！！
您的物品欄已滿。
無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text:
She's unconscious.
I can see a bandage to stop the bleeding...
Looks like Luik did it.
scripts.translation:
她昏迷不醒。
我看到有繃帶在止血...
看來是盧伊克做的。

scripts.text:
Luik and Snorren did everything to extract juice out of a Yggdrasilberry
chopped and stuffed it into a mouth and paste them on the body...
scripts.translation:
盧伊克和斯諾倫為了榨取世界樹漿液，
切開了漿果塞進嘴裡，然後塗抹在身體上...

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉菲尼]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Finally she's coming to.
Ok, {0}, it's up to you now.
And you better not fake any of the words she's saying.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
她終於醒了。
好了，{0}，現在輪到你了。
你最好別偽造她說的任何話。

scripts.text: - I nod to Luik and began talking to the Laphine. -
scripts.translation: - 我向盧伊克點頭示意，開始與拉菲尼交談。 -

scripts.text: - After the Laphine gained her full consciousness, she gazed around and spoke in shaky voice. -
scripts.translation: - 拉菲尼完全恢復意識後，環顧四周，用顫抖的聲音說道。 -

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Where... am I?
Oh My! That's right! I need Bradium!
Get me out of here!
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉菲尼]
我...在哪裡？
天哪！對了！我需要魔力之石！
快放我出去！

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
If I don't go back to him quickly, he... he is going to die!!
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉菲尼]
如果我不快點回去找他，他...他就要死了！！

scripts.text: Who is HE?
scripts.translation: 他是誰？

scripts.text: Is your name Terra?
scripts.translation: 他叫泰拉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
A giant... a giant in a cave...
He...He got hurt trying to protect me...
He wouldn't move!
His body was getting cold.
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉菲尼]
一個巨人...洞穴裡的巨人...
他...他為了保護我受了傷...
他動不了了！
他的身體正在變冷。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
We were each other's enemy......
but he saved me...
I heard they need a bradium to live!
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉菲尼]
我們本是敵人......
但他救了我...
我聽說他們需要魔力之石才能活命！

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Give me some bradium. Hurry!
I can't be late!
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉菲尼]
給我一些魔力之石。快！
我不能遲到！

scripts.text: You are Terra. Right?
scripts.translation: 你是泰拉，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Terra]
How...How do you know my name?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
你...你怎麼知道我的名字？
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Arc asked me to find you. So I came here.
By the way.. You were saying about a giant, do you mean a Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是阿克讓我來找你的。所以我來了這裡。
順便問一下...你剛才提到一個巨人，你是指薩法嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Sapha in the cave...
His body was already petrified when I got there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洞穴裡的薩法...
我趕到那裡時，他的身體已經石化了。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Giants.. It is said that the Sapha people are cursed to be petrified.
And that the Bradium is what prevents them from becoming petrified.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
巨人...據說薩法一族被詛咒會石化。
而魔力之石可以防止他們石化。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So I tried to bring a bradium to him... ...
But he... Sob...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以我試著給他帶了一塊魔力之石... ...
但是他...嗚...

scripts.text: - Terra couldn't continue to talk as she was agonizing in the pain from her wounds. -
scripts.translation: - 泰拉因傷口的劇痛而痛苦不堪，無法繼續說話。 -

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Why did she break down like that? What did she say?
Tell me what she said!!!
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
她為什麼突然崩潰了？她說了什麼？
告訴我她說了什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
How...How do you know my name?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
你...你怎麼知道我的名字？
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came looking for you on behalf of Arc.
Just how did you end up here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受阿克之託來找你的。
你究竟是怎麼落到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Terra]
To find a... Bra.. dium.
That's right. Bradium! Give me a bradium!!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
去找...魔...力之石。
沒錯。魔力之石！給我一塊魔力之石！！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
A giant... a giant in a cave...
He...He got hurt trying to protect me...
He wouldn't move!
His body was getting cold.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
一個巨人...洞穴裡的巨人...
他...他為了保護我受了傷...
他動不了了！
他的身體正在變冷。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
We were each other's enemy......
but he saved me...
I heard they need a bradium to live!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
我們本是敵人......
但他救了我...
我聽說他們需要魔力之石才能活命！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Give me some bradium. Hurry!
I can't be late!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
給我一些魔力之石。快！
我不能遲到！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Sapha in the cave...
His body was already petrified when I got there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洞穴裡的薩法...
我趕到那裡時，他的身體已經石化了。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Giants.. It is said that the Sapha people are cursed to be petrified.
And that the Bradium is what prevents them from becoming petrified.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
巨人...據說薩法一族被詛咒會石化。
而魔力之石可以防止他們石化。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So I tried to bring a bradium to him... ...
But he... Sob...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以我試著給他帶了一塊魔力之石... ...
但是他...嗚...

scripts.text: - Terra couldn't continue to talk as she was agonizing in the pain from her wounds. -
scripts.translation: - 泰拉因傷口的劇痛而痛苦不堪，無法繼續說話。 -

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Why did she break down like that? What did she say?
Tell me what she said!!!
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
她為什麼突然崩潰了？她說了什麼？
告訴我她說了什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Let that Fairy rest for a while, now tell me what you were talking about.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
讓那個妖精先休息一會兒，現在告訴我你們剛才在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
She's just too exhausted and fell asleep...
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
她只是太累了，睡著了...
別打擾她。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
She can leave any time she likes.
It feels so dry in here.
Oh well, that's normal.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
她想走隨時都可以走。
這裡感覺好乾燥。
算了，這很正常。

scripts.text:
She's unconscious.
I can see a bandage to stop the bleeding...
Looks like Luik did it.
scripts.translation:
她昏迷不醒。
我看到有繃帶在止血...
看來是盧伊克做的。

[Luik]
Ier er ee ras d?
Ye ada sd?
Nffd..?
scripts.translation:

Should we just let her eat it as it is?
scripts.translation:

給，盧伊克。他說這是拉菲尼的解藥。
我們要不要直接讓她吃下去？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh.. and your name was..?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
呃...還有，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah, Right.
{0}, you should try talking to that Laphine...
Let's hear her story.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
沒錯，就是這樣。
{0}，你應該試著和那個拉菲尼對話...
聽聽她的故事。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Please help me translater.
We'll be watching as you speak to her.
Right, Luik?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
請幫我翻譯一下。
我們會在一旁看著你們對話。
對吧，盧伊克？

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Maybe.
Let's ask her what happened, before it is too late.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
也許吧。
在一切太遲之前，先問問她發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Let's listen to her story.
Why don't we start from... Why does she want a bradium?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
讓我們聽聽她的故事。
我們要不先從...她為什麼想要魔力之石開始問起？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This part must be told to Luik in exact detail.
scripts.translation:

這部分必須向盧伊克詳細地說明。

scripts.text:

What should I do if the Sapha in the Cave is really Ogen...?
Ogen... What should I do if anything happened to him...?
scripts.translation:

如果洞穴裡的薩法真的是奧根...
奧根...如果對他出了什麼事，我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:

and, this muffler...
scripts.translation:

...這塊魔力之石沒有經過正確的精煉...
這幫不上什麼忙...
還有，這條圍巾...

scripts.text:

This is Ogen's! Ogen's muffler!
Luik! Ogen! This is Ogen!
Unrefined Bradium!
scripts.translation:

這是奧根的！奧根的圍巾！
盧伊克！奧根！這是奧根！
未精煉的魔力之石！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Lu.. Luik. Ogen.. Ogen...?!
I'm going to Ogen!
Where is that cave?! Where!
scripts.translation:

盧...盧伊克。奧根...奧根...？！
我要去找奧根！
那個洞穴在哪裡？！在哪裡！

scripts.text: Calm down!
scripts.translation: 冷靜點！

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Yeah. Listen to him, calm down. Snorren.
If it is Ogen... We could be able to save him if we make haste.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
是啊。聽他的，冷靜點，斯諾倫。
如果是奧根...如果我們動作快一點，也許還能救他。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Snorren. Go to Refinery and get the finest bradium...
Save him.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
斯諾倫。去精煉廠拿最好的魔力之石...
救他。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
{0}...eh?...
Please look after Snorren...and Ogen.
This Laphine, I mean Terra...
She truly wanted to save Ogen...
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
{0}...嗯？...
請照顧好斯諾倫...還有奧根。
這個拉菲尼，我是說泰拉...
她真的是想救奧根...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
I will talk to my superiors to try and settle this matter...
Please save Ogen.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
我會和我的上級談談，試著解決這件事...
請救救奧根。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
You should bring something that can prove it?
... We have been fighting them for so long, it is hard for us to believe you.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
你應該帶點能證明的東西吧？
...我們和他們戰鬥了這麼久，很難相信你的話。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
...Yes... regardless of anything, just to prove what you say is true.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
...是的...不管發生什麼，只要能證明你說的是真的。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Hurry up and take the lead!
Which way should we go now?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
快點，帶路！
我們現在該往哪邊走？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
How did you get in here?!
Get out!
scripts.translation:

出去！

scripts.text:
[Luik]
...I really look forward to drawing something useful out of her.
Your interpretion is trustworthy, right?
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
...我真希望能從她那裡問出點有用的東西。
你的翻譯是可信的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Luik]
First of all, Why did that Laphine come here?
Why does she need a bradium?
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
首先，那個拉芬為什麼來這裡？
她為什麼需要魔力之石？

scripts.text: To give it to a Sapha in a cave...
scripts.translation: 為了把它交給洞穴裡的薩法...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Sapha in a cave? What cave?
Nevermind.... Snorren. You must know something about that cave, right?
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
洞穴裡的薩法？哪個洞穴？
算了...斯諾倫。你肯定知道那個洞穴的事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Wait...
Why would a Laphine give a bradium to our ally?
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
等等...
拉芬為什麼要給盟友魔力之石？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They fought in the cave and your friend got hurt and began to petrify.
So she came here to get a bradium to try to save his life...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們在洞穴裡戰鬥，你的朋友受了傷，開始石化。
所以她來這裡找魔力之石，想救他的命...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
They fought?
Snorren! What's that look on your face?
Spit if out if you have anything to say.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
戰鬥？
斯諾倫！你臉上那是什麼表情？
有話就直說。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Frankly, Luik. I... told you... Ogen's missing.
Ogen's disappearance and that Laphine's arrival coincide...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
說實話，盧伊克。我...告訴過你...奧根失蹤了。
奧根失蹤和那個拉芬的到來時間吻合...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
And?
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
然後呢？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Maybe the Sapha that Laphine is talking about is Ogen.
Or do we have any other comrades who go to strange caves?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
也許拉芬提到的那個薩法就是奧根。
難道我們還有其他同志會去那種奇怪的洞穴嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luik]
We don't, because there are no caves like that here.
First, we should find out about the cave they are talking about.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
沒有，因為這裡沒有那樣的洞穴。
首先，我們應該弄清楚他們說的是哪個洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
You outsiders are in contact with the Laphine right?
What if this is an evil plot by them?
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
你們這些外來者一直和拉芬保持聯絡，對吧？
萬一這是他們的陰謀呢？

scripts.text: That's not true!
scripts.translation: 那不是真的！

scripts.text:
[Luik]
And how would you prove it?
We've been fighting them for a long time.
We don't have any reason to trust what you or they are saying.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
你打算怎麼證明？
我們和他們鬥爭了很久。
我們沒有理由相信你們或他們說的話。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
And talking about some cave that doesn't even exist.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
而且還在談論一個根本不存在的洞穴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That cave really exists, I swear!
I.. yeah. I saw a petrified Sapha in that cave.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個洞穴真的存在，我發誓！
我...是的。我在那個洞穴裡看到了一個石化的薩法。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will bring back something that will make you believe.
I'm not sure if that Sapha is this Ogen you are looking for...
But I'll come back...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會帶一樣東西回來讓你們相信。
我不確定那個薩法是不是你們在找的奧根...
但我一定會回來...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you dare...try to do any harm to Terra.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們敢...對泰拉做任何傷害。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
...Anything will do. Try and make me believe you -Outsider- and that Laphine.
We Sapha are not stupid people.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
...隨便你們怎麼做。試著讓我相信你們——外來者——和那個拉芬。
我們薩法不是愚蠢的人。

I promise you that we will continue to treat that Laphine as we did so far and will not do any harm to her.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
我保證，我們會像以前一樣對待那個拉芬，不會傷害她。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Hence, you just focus on finding a way to make us believe you.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Please... Help Ogen.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
請...救救奧根。

scripts.text:

How did you get in here?
You shouldn't be here.
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克]
你是怎麼進來的？
你不該出現在這裡。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Looks like Luik is giving me a look of scorn.
scripts.translation: 盧伊克正用輕蔑的眼神看著我。

scripts.text:
There's nothing else.
Only traces of the cage with something confined.
scripts.translation:
沒有別的東西了。
只有被囚禁在籠子裡的某物的痕跡。

[Arc]
I see. That's what happened.
But... That Sapha...What has he become to you in that short period of time?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我明白了。事情就是這樣發生的。
但是...那個薩法...在這麼短的時間裡，他對你來說變成了什麼？

scripts.text: Arc?
scripts.translation: 阿克？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, finally. I've been speaking with Terra while we waited for you.
Terra. This is who saved you...
You should thank {0}
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，終於來了。在你等待的時候，我和泰拉聊了一會兒。
泰拉。這位就是救了你的人...
你應該感謝{0}

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Thank you...
I'm sorry Arc... Sorry...
......
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
謝謝你...
對不起，阿克...對不起...
......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
So, this is the story.
Terra was wandering around your Camp and found a Sapha who was also wandering around your Camp at the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
所以，事情是這樣的。
泰拉在你的營地附近徘徊，當時也發現了一個在你的營地附近徘徊的薩法。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
They were both being cautious not to be seen by you humans but they caught sight of each other and started to fight.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
他們都很小心，不想被你們人類發現，但他們看到了彼此，於是開始戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
And then they eventually fell into that hole in the swamp and ended up in that cave.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
然後他們最終掉進了沼澤裡的那個洞裡，來到了那個洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Terra]

scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
是的...我們昏迷了一段時間..
等我們醒來並看清周圍時...我們已經被包圍了。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Our main concern was getting out of there...
Even though we couldn't understand each other's language... We made a temporary truce.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
我們最擔心的是如何逃出去...
雖然我們無法理解彼此的語言...但我們達成了暫時的停戰協議。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
And then.....
.........
So that's what happened.
scripts.translation: 原來是這樣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You were outnumbered and at the last moment Ogen sacrificed himself to protect you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們寡不敵眾，在最後關頭，奧根犧牲了自己來保護你。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So... I wanted to help him...
I was just trying to repay him...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以...我想幫他...
我只是想報答他...

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Was I wrong...?
Was I thinking wrong?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
我錯了嗎...？
我的想法錯了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Repaying one's dept is a good thing.
Especially for a proud Laphine, It sure is.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
償還債務是好事。
尤其是對於驕傲的拉芬來說，更是如此。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
But Terra...
You've made two big mistakes.
First is, You went away without permission...
And secondly...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
但是泰拉...
你犯了兩個大錯。
第一，你未經許可就離開了...
第二...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You didn't ask for help.
If something like that happened... of course I would help...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你沒有尋求幫助。
如果發生了那樣的事...我當然會幫忙...

scripts.text:
[Terra]
I'm sorry Arc... I'm sorry...
I won't act foolish ever again.
scripts.translation:

進展如何？

scripts.text: Give him the Gem.
scripts.translation: 給他寶石

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Ah, Looks like you've succeeded.
Inputting data into a gem with a magical power... It's something you can't do with a technology... It's a bit resentful to admit, but it's magnificent.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
啊，看來你成功了。
用魔力將資料輸入寶石...這是科技做不到的事...雖然有點不甘心承認，但這確實很了不起。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Well then, I should be working on making a machine to read the magical data in this Gem so we could use them right away.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
那麼，我得著手製造一臺能讀取寶石中魔法資料的機器，這樣我們就能立刻使用它們了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Hmm...
Fortunately, It won't be as hard as we thought.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
嗯...
幸好，這不會像我們想像的那麼難。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
If we transform a magical power wave to an eletric signal and connect it to a human body, then transmit a data to a brain directly. That will allow us to receive and understand a data without any loading process.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
如果我們把魔力波轉換成電訊號，並將其連線到人體，然後直接將資料傳輸到大腦。這樣我們就可以在沒有載入過程的情況下接收並理解資料。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I don't have time to explain everything. I have to start the work right away.
With all preperation done, allow me about one hour to finish this thing.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
我沒有時間解釋所有細節。我必須立刻開始工作。
在一切準備就緒後，請給我大約一個小時來完成這件事。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Sigh, What should I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
唉，我現在該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
- Dorance is walking here and there -
- in a dither. -
scripts.translation:
- 多蘭斯正 -
- 焦急地來回踱步。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is something wrong?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出什麼事了？！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
What should I do?! Ain't I REALLY a genius?!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
我該怎麼辦？！難道我不是個天才嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I've made it!!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
我成功了！！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Convenient portable size!
Fashionable and practical design!
Features the Other World's Words / Idiom / Grammer / Phrases!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
便攜尺寸，方便攜帶！
時尚且實用的設計！
收錄了異世界的詞彙/成語/語法/短語！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Have you experienced the loading speed?
Don't you even mention it if you haven't.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
你體驗過載入速度了嗎？
如果你沒體驗過，就別提了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
That's not all!
For the Well-Being life, it will buff your strength and intelligence!!!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
不僅如此！
為了健康生活，它會提升你的力量和智力！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
With all these marvelous features, it's just 39,900 zeny....!!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
擁有這麼多神奇的功能，只要39,900 Zeny....!!!

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Just what are you trying to imitate...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...你這是在模仿什麼...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Important thing is, I've made it!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
重要的是，我把它做出來了！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Well, Seeing is believing.
Take a look.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
好吧，眼見為實。
請過目。

scripts.text: - He handed over the small ring. -
scripts.translation: - 他遞過來一枚小戒指。 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
The name is 'the Ring of Wise King'. I designed it after the Ring used by ancient king to communicate with animals.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
它的名字是“智者之戒”。我是參考古代國王用來與動物交流的戒指設計的。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Do not just look at it like any other rings. You see this small gem here? This socket which holds a gem and a ring part are precisely crafted, it will transform a magical power wave to electric signal and trasmit it directly to our brain.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
別把它當成普通的戒指看。你看這裡的小寶石？這個鑲嵌寶石的插槽和戒指部分都是精密製造的，它會將魔力波轉換為電訊號，並直接傳輸到我們的大腦。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Since this electric signal is same as the signal used by our body's nerve system, it will enable us to understand and use the language fluently.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
由於這種電訊號與我們身體神經系統使用的訊號相同，它將使我們能夠流利地理解和使用語言。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Once this translator gets popularized, it'd be just a matter of time for us to advance into the other world. Well, the problem is...we don't have enough quantity yet...
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
一旦這種翻譯器普及，我們進入異世界就只是時間問題了。嗯，問題是...我們目前的數量還不夠...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Hmm...
Anyways, now we've got the idea, I will give you this first piece of work.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
嗯...
總之，既然我們已經有了這個想法，我就把這個初版作品給你吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Thank you for helping us out.
I hope this ring would be a big help for your journey through the other world.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
謝謝你的幫助。
希望這枚戒指能對你在異世界的旅程大有幫助。

scripts.text:
- He has scattered mechanical parts -
- all over the room and so wrapped up -
- in his work -
scripts.translation:
- 他把機械零件 -
- 撒得滿屋子都是，而且完全 -
- 沉浸在工作中 -

scripts.text:
- I might get bitten if I bother him -
- Let's leave him alone -
scripts.translation:
- 打擾他可能會被咬 -
- 還是別管他了 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I hope this ring would be a big help for your journey through the other world.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
希望這枚戒指能對你在異世界的旅程大有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Do you know about the Ring of Ancient Wise King? If you wear that Ring, you could talk to an animal.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
你聽說過“古代智王戒指”嗎？戴上那枚戒指，你就能與動物對話了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I don't know if it is a legend based on a truth or not... something like that will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
我不知道這究竟是傳說還是事實...但那樣的東西一定會派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
By the way, Who are you? This building is under Commander's control. This place is not to be entered freely... Are you acquainted with our Commander?
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
順便問一下，你是誰？這棟建築歸指揮官管轄。這裡不是誰都能隨便進的...你認識我們的指揮官嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Are you looking for something to do? Perhaps I could use some help... Well, I don't know if you are trustworthy just yet.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
你在找事情做嗎？也許我能幫上忙...不過，我還不確定你是否值得信賴。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
If you are good enough to solve some problems within the expedition camp, and carry out a mission given by Commander... then I think I could trust you.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師 多蘭斯]
如果你能解決遠征營裡的一些問題，並執行指揮官下達的任務...我想我就可以信任你了。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language distinguishes humans from animals. Every single intellectual life form has their own language.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
語言將人類與動物區分開來。每一個擁有智慧的生命形式都有它們自己的語言。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language is a method / system which delievers one's feeling or thinking by voice or letters. Anyway, its purpose is to communicate.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
語言是一種通過聲音或文字傳達情感或思想的系統。無論如何，它的目的都是溝通。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Difference between a language and a sound is that language is a socially implied promise by making common system of communication to make it possible to understand eachother.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
語言與聲音的區別在於，語言是一種社會性的約定，通過建立共同的溝通系統來使彼此能夠理解。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
That Socially implied promise, if we could grasp the meaning of a system and structure, we will be able to understand other intellectual life form's language...
...................................And just who might you be?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
這種社會性的約定，如果我們能掌握其系統和結構，就能理解其他智慧生命的語言...
...................................那麼，你究竟是誰？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

這裡是受我們指揮官管控的禁區。沒有經過正式批准，誰都不能進入...你認識我們的指揮官嗎？

scripts.text: I am Me!
scripts.translation: 是我！

scripts.text: I don't have a name to tell you!
scripts.translation: 我沒有名字可以告訴你！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
What the heck?
If you are so bored, why don't you go fishing?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
真是的？
如果你這麼無聊，為什麼不去釣魚呢？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Ah~ I've heard from our Commander about you. You've done much for the Midgard Alliance Camp. Anyways, what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
啊~ 我從我們指揮官那裡聽說過你。你為米德加爾特聯盟營地做了很多事。總之，是什麼把你帶到這裡來的？

scripts.text: I thought I had confused you a bit...
scripts.translation: 我以為我讓你有點困惑了...

scripts.text: What were you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Confusion is a feeling that comes from distraction of one's mind when something that couldn't be predicted happens. I'm not a person who easily gets confused.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
困惑是一種當發生無法預測的事情時，因心神分散而產生的感覺。我不是一個容易感到困惑的人。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
I'm a linguist from Arunafeltz. I'm a scholor who studies a system and a structure of every kinds of language in the world.
And...don't you think the reason man like me is here is that there's a predictable cause?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
我是來自阿魯納菲茲的語言學家。我是一名研究世界上各種語言系統和結構的學者。
而且...你不覺得像我這樣的人出現在這裡，是有可預測的原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
From what I heard, you've done much for the Midgard Alliance Research Group.
And while you were helping us, I believe you've seen and visited many places here in the other world.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
據我所知，你為米德加爾特聯盟研究組做了很多事。
在你幫助我們期間，我相信你在這個異世界見過並造訪過許多地方。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Have you met the other world's people by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
你碰巧見過異世界的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Looks like you haven't encountered them yet.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
看來你還沒有遇到他們。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Rumor here says that there's a fairy-looking and a giant wood people living out in the fields next to our camp here.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
這裡的傳聞說，在我們營地旁邊的野外，住著像妖精一樣的人和巨大的木人。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Apparently these people are speaking in a strange languages that we humans can't understand...but no one seems to be able to remember how their languages sound like.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
據說這些人說著一種奇怪的語言，我們人類無法理解...但似乎沒人能記得他們的語言聽起來是什麼樣的。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
A NEW language!! This is an exciting discovery for a linguist like myself, but as you know, there's dangerous monsters outside... It's not possible for a mere scholor to go out wandering around.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
一種新的語言！！對於像我這樣的語言學家來說，這是一個令人興奮的發現，但你知道的，外面有危險的魔物...一個普通的學者不可能出去四處遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
I've said this much, I think you'd be able to guess what I'm going to ask you to do.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
我說到這裡，我想你應該能猜到我要讓你做什麼了。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
The Alliance Research Group has great interest in other intelligent life. Each country's secret agents are making every effort to communicate with those two races, there's just not enough information.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
聯盟研究組對其他智慧生命非常感興趣。各國的特工都在努力與這兩個種族溝通，只是資訊還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Do me a favor and go outside of the camp, find the fairies and wooden giants, and remember everything that they are saying, word for word so that I can hear what their language sounds like.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
幫我個忙，去營地外面，找到妖精和木巨人，並一字不差地記住他們說的每一句話，這樣我就能聽到他們的語言是什麼樣的了。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
From the look on your face, I think you have something crossed in your mind.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
從你的表情來看，我想你心裡有些疑惑。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
You are back!
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
你回來了！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
So, What were they saying?
Of course you remember them exactly as what they've said, right?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
那麼，他們說了什麼？
當然，你記得他們說的每一個字，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Now, let's start with the Fairies! What is the fairy's language like? Please write them down here sentence by sentence!
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
現在，讓我們從妖精開始！妖精的語言是什麼樣的？請逐句寫在這裡！

scripts.text:

{0}....
And?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
{0}...
然後呢？

scripts.text:
{0}....
Is that all?

{0}....
Is that all?

[Linguist Dictionary]
So...If we put'em together,
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!
It'd be like this.
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
那麼...如果我們把它們拼在一起，
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!
就會是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Hmm...?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
You sure this is exactly what they've said?
I can't understand anything from this...
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
你確定這就是他們說的原話嗎？
我從這裡完全看不懂...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Would you please go back again and check if it is exactly what they were saying?
scripts.translation:
[語言學家 字典]
請你再回去確認一下，這是否真的是他們說的原話？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Good. then next is the Wooden Giants! What's their language like? Write them down sentence by sentence just as you did with the Fairy's.

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
I almost forgot! You should be careful when you dig for the Gem.
Assassins installed a trap to protect Gems as they bury them.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
我差點忘了！挖掘寶石時要小心。
刺客們在埋藏寶石時設定了陷阱來保護它們。

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
Well, if you are not busy at the time, please go check how's the Linguist from Arunafeltz's research is coming up.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
嗯，如果你當時不忙的話，請去看看阿魯納菲茲的語言學家研究得怎麼樣了。

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
I should be working on extracting voice data and send them to the Linguist from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
我應該正在提取聲音資料併發送給阿魯納菲茲的語言學家。

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
Hmm...There's more data than we thought...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
嗯...資料比我們想像的多...

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
Of course it is a piece of cake to turn data into magical power and put'em into a gem...Most important thing is, I don't know if there's a jewl that has enough storage space to store that much of data...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
將資料轉化為魔力並注入寶石中，這對我來說是小菜一碟...最關鍵的是，我不知道有沒有足夠大的寶石能儲存這麼多資料...

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
I heard that cold side of a field outside of the Expedition Camp, ^0000ff Mysterious Ore that can't be found in the Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
我聽說在遠征營地外的一片寒冷地帶，有一種在米德加爾特找不到的^0000ff神秘礦石。

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
Only if we could find that ore, it would make this work much easier... What do you think about that? Do you think you could go and find one for me?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
如果我們能找到那種礦石，這項工作就會輕鬆許多...你覺得怎麼樣？你能去幫我找一個嗎？

scripts.text:

While you are gone, I will organize the data to put into the Gem.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
Oh! Is this that ore?
scripts.translation:

哦！這就是那種礦石嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
This sure is interesting. It has not been refined yet, but I can sense mysterious power from this ore.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
這真有趣。雖然還沒有經過提煉，但我能感覺到這塊礦石中蘊含著神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
It's something like... the special wave with a life force.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
那感覺就像是...一種帶有生命力的特殊波動。

scripts.text:
[Magician Whisper]
Let's test and see see how much magical power it could store.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 低語]
讓我們測試一下，看看它能儲存多少魔力。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, it seems like my skin is becoming really dry.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
最近，我的皮膚似乎變得非常乾燥。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It looks like you're carrying too many things.
Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
看起來你攜帶了太多物品。
為什麼不把一些物品存入倉庫，然後再回來呢？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I do not have any need of your help right now.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
薩法的未來掌握在你手中。
我現在不需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, someone who came from Schwarzwald gave me a small mineral as a gift from his home town when he saw our study of Bradium.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
最近，一位來自修瓦魯茲巴魯德的人看到我們在研究魔力之石，便送了一塊來自他家鄉的小礦石作為禮物。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Oh! Yes, that's it!
This much will be enough!
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
哦！是的，就是這個！
這些足夠了！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
薩法的未來掌握在你手中。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I don't know if it's caused by the cold weather or our chronic disease getting worse.
It hasn't been too long since we administered the Bradium, so why.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我不知道這是由寒冷天氣引起的，還是我們的慢性病惡化了。
我們使用魔力之石的時間並不長，為什麼會這樣呢。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Huu... You see, we are afraid of such things... What a hard life.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
呼...你看，我們害怕這樣的事情...真是艱難的生活。

scripts.text: A chronic disease?
scripts.translation: 慢性病？

scripts.text: Bradium?
scripts.translation: 魔力之石？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
We Sapha, who are descendants of Hwergelmir, survived and rebuilt the Giant tribe in the flood of the blood of Ymir.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我們薩法，作為赫瓦格密爾的子孫，在尤彌爾的血流洪水中倖存下來，並重建了巨人部落。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
For no apparent reason, we developed a chronic disease that makes our bodies dry and harden over time just like an old tree.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
不知為何，我們患上了一種慢性病，使我們的身體像老樹一樣隨時間變得乾燥和硬化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I think that this is the curse of Ymir who bled by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我想這是被眾神放血的尤彌爾施加的詛咒？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But we couldn't just wait for death to slowly creep up on us and exterminate our entire race.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
但我們不能只是坐以待斃，看著死亡慢慢逼近並滅絕我們整個種族。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
To heal this rare disease the smartest Sapha studied and studied.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
為了治癒這種罕見疾病，薩法中最聰明的族人進行了反覆的研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
What they found was that by injecting a refined Bradium, which is buried around Jotunheim, it can postpone the progression of the disease.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
他們發現，注射埋藏在約頓海姆周圍的精煉魔力之石，可以延緩病情的惡化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
So all of the giants of Sapha established their towns around mines to get Bradium easier.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
因此，薩法的所有巨人都選擇在礦脈附近建立城鎮，以便更容易獲取魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It seems the amount of buried Bradium is enough.
But for the eternal prosperity of our tribe, and to make the vaccine for this incurable disease, we have to study more and more.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
目前埋藏的魔力之石數量似乎還足夠。
但為了我們種族的永恆繁榮，以及研製出針對這種絕症的疫苗，我們必須進行更深入的研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Bradium is the stem of our life.
But the buried Bradium will be exhausted someday, so we Scientists have to find an alternative for our descendants.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
魔力之石是我們生命的支柱。
但埋藏的魔力之石終有一天會枯竭，所以我們科學家必須為後代尋找替代品。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, we've learned that there are various minerals in the human world Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
最近，我們得知人類世界米德加爾特擁有各種各樣的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Now the world called Midgard is
like a holy place for us,
which can bring the wind of
revolution for us.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
如今，被稱為米德加爾特的世界對我們來說宛如聖地，
它能為我們帶來變革的契機。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Contact with Midgard
must be the lead of Hwergelmir
for us, the Sapha which has such
a closed-off society.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
對於像我們薩法這樣封閉的社會來說，
與米德加爾特建立聯絡，
必定是赫瓦格密爾指引的方向。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I'll draw a result that can
satisfy his lead!
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我將得出一個能令其指引滿意的結果！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I can't say for sure until now,
but this mineral seems to have
many interesting features.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
目前我還無法確定，
但這種礦石似乎具有許多有趣的特性。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
As I examine this mineral
more and more, it's really
different from the one in Jotunheim.
This mineral must be helpful
to make a new vaccine!

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
It looks like you're carrying too many things.
Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?

[格勒努伊]
看起來你攜帶的東西太多了。
為什麼不把一些物品存入倉庫，然後再回來呢？

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I've heard that some strangers from Midgard are around here, it must be you.
I'm Grenouille, a scientist.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我聽說有一些來自米德加爾特的外鄉人在附近，一定是你們吧。
我是格勒努伊，一名科學家。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
It's been a long time since
the Laphine built the Splendide camp here
and confronted each other.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
拉斐恩人在這裡建立輝煌領域營地，並相互對峙，已經很久了。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
A number of soldiers who
left their hometown Alfheim are
restraining them with fighting against
the harsh cold of Jotunheim
for the holy duty and the faith to
stop the evil attempts to
sickening Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
許多離開家鄉阿爾弗雷姆計程車兵，為了神聖的職責和阻止邪惡勢力侵蝕世界樹的信念，正在與約頓海姆的嚴寒搏鬥，以壓制他們。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
They're well trained soldiers,
and their captains hold them in high esteem,
so they're enjoying a
comfortable life there.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
他們是訓練有素計程車兵，他們的船長對他們評價很高，所以他們在那裡過著舒適的生活。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
But there's a saying that
constant dripping water
wears away the stone.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
但俗話說，水滴石穿。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Continuous small battles without big progression
makes the soldiers in Splendide exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
持續的小規模戰鬥而沒有大的進展，讓輝煌領域計程車兵們精疲力竭。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
One day, someone began to sing
a song of Alfheim, that spread rapidly...
Now they strongly
miss their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有一天，有人開始唱一首關於阿爾弗雷姆的歌，這首歌迅速傳開了...
現在他們非常想念家鄉。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I was so worried about them and
I finally found a way to
save them from the deep sadness.
I hope you to help me to do that.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我很擔心他們，
終於找到了一個方法
讓他們擺脫深深的悲傷。
希望你能幫我做到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There's a Laphine General
who is called Flowery,
in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
在輝煌領域，
有一位被稱為“花兒”的
拉菲涅將軍。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
She is a collecting maniac,
so her house is always
in a mess with miscellaneous
things. Flowery must have
seeds from the flowers
of Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
她是個收藏狂，
所以她的房子總是
堆滿了各種雜物。
花兒一定擁有
來自阿爾弗雷姆的花的種子。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I'll make the flower of
Alfheim open with the seed.
The flower of their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我會用種子
讓阿爾弗雷姆的花綻放。
那是他們家鄉的花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There are some devices that purify
the environment and have a function
that can hasten the growth of plants.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有一些裝置可以淨化環境，
並且具有
加速植物生長的功能。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Please bring me the flower of Alfheim that bloomed by the device.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
請帶給我那朵
由裝置催開的阿爾弗雷姆之花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
The flower of Alfheim is not
strong enough to keep it's life by
depending on the Splendide device,
but ^FF0000the way^000000 can fill
Splendide by it's scent like it never falls!
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
阿爾弗雷姆之花
不夠強壯，無法僅靠
輝煌領域的裝置維持生命，
但^FF0000它的方式^000000能讓它的香氣
充滿輝煌領域，彷彿永不凋謝！

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Get a seed from Flowery,
and then use a Purifier
to make the seed blossom.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
從花兒那裡拿到種子，
然後使用淨化器
讓種子綻放。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Hoo, this is one of the
most common kinds of flowers.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
呼，這是
最常見的一種花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Haha, Don't worry.
Common flowers like this can bring the familiarity of home back to the soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
哈哈，別擔心。
像這樣普通的花
能讓士兵們找回家的熟悉感。

scripts.text:

includes the scent of this flower by using a distiller.
Making a ^3131FFPerfume^000000.
