 - 他似乎被深深吸引了。 - 
 - 最好讓他一個人待著。 - 
 - 讓他看完。 -

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
Mm...there are actually such things?!
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
嗯...竟然真的有這種東西？！

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
Mm...I see, I see.
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
嗯...我明白了，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
Even though the content is simple, it's well organized and interesting.
As expected of {0}!!
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
雖然內容很簡單，但條理清晰，很有趣。
不愧是{0}！！

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
You've done well.
You must be exhausted. Go take a rest. We'll continue tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
你做得很好。
你一定累壞了。去休息一下吧，我們明天繼續。

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
Ah... this isn't much, but it's a coin that the giants use.
Maybe you can buy something from them with this.
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
啊...雖然不多，但這是巨人使用的硬幣。
也許你可以用它從他們那裡買些東西。

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
Take it easy...
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
別太在意...

scripts.text:
[Bazett]
You've done well.
You must be exhausted. Go take a rest, we'll continue tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[巴澤特]
你做得很好。
你一定累壞了。去休息一下吧，我們明天繼續。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oops, it's dangerous, almost broken.
I should hurry to change it...otherwise.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哎呀，很危險，快斷了。
我得趕緊換掉...不然的話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's the matter?

[Worker]
Ah....here.....um...
......
.........
Nothing!!

[{0}]
What's up?

[Worker]
You are an outsider.
......
I was suprised by your voice.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你是外人。
......
我被你的聲音嚇了一跳。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sorry to startle you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，抱歉嚇到你了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Haha, it's ok.
Recently I heard about people like you but it's the first time I've actually met one.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哈哈，沒關係。
最近我聽說過像你這樣的人，但這是第一次真正見到。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
You speak our language pretty good.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你的語言說得很好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...anyway..you look like you're having some trouble. What happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...總之...你看起來遇到了麻煩。發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Nothing!!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
沒什麼！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you sure? Fate has to have brought us together for a reason.
Tell me~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你確定嗎？命運讓我們相遇一定是有原因的。
告訴我吧~

scripts.text:
[Worker]
......
Frankly...

[Worker]
The screw is too old to use to fix the tent, so I should change it before it breaks.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
螺絲太舊了，沒法用來固定帳篷，所以我得在它斷掉之前換掉。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I can't leave so I'm just waiting for my friend to pass by to help me.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我走不開，只能等我的朋友路過時來幫我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以幫你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No~that's alright. We just met so I can't ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不~沒關係。我們才剛認識，不能麻煩你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's ok! We can help each other!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係！我們可以互相幫助！

scripts.text: - Suddenly there is a screeching sound as the screw breaks -
scripts.translation: - 突然傳來一聲刺耳的響聲，螺絲斷了 -

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Ugh!!!
**Sigh**

[Worker]
Well that's that!
Anyway my name is ^0000FFGill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這下完了！
總之，我叫^0000FF吉爾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
I need something to fix the tent with, if you can get^0000FF 30 Horn of Hillslion^000000, I can make them into sturdy enough screws.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
我需要一些東西來修帳篷，如果你能弄到^0000FF 30個希斯利安之角^000000，我就能把它們做成足夠結實的螺絲。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
Sorry, again for making you do this but I will be waiting here for you.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
抱歉又讓你跑一趟了，我會在這裡等你的。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
You helped me collect all of the Horns of Hillslion?
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
你幫我收集齊了所有的希斯利安之角？
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
It's all because of you, we are able to prevent anything disastrous.
^0000FFEven though you're also an alien race, but compared to the vile fairies^000000, I'm glad to have met someone like {0}.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
多虧了你，我們才得以避免災難發生。
^0000FF雖然你也是異族，但比起那些邪惡的妖精^000000，我很高興能遇到像{0}這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
Sorry, again for making you do this but I will be waiting here for you to bring back the^0000FF 30 Horn of Hillslions.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
抱歉又讓你跑一趟了，我會在這裡等你帶^0000FF 30個希斯利安之角^000000回來。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
Thank you for helping me.
^0000FFEven though you're also an alien race, but compared to the vile fairies^000000, I'm glad to have met someone like {0}.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
謝謝你的幫助。
^0000FF雖然你也是異族，但比起那些邪惡的妖精^000000，我很高興能遇到像{0}這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
This is too dangerous, it's become too loose...
It must be replaced soon...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這太危險了，已經變得太鬆了...
必須儘快更換...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
This is too dangerous, it's become too loose...
It must be replaced soon...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這太危險了，已經變得太鬆了...
必須儘快更換...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Ah... see here...
......
.........
Nevermind. Nothing.

[{0}]
You don't have to be like this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不用這樣。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
You are one of the strange race, aren't you?
......
To suddenly hear you speak our language gave me a bit of a shock.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你是那個奇怪的種族之一，對吧？
......
突然聽到你說我們的語言，讓我有點震驚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since I'm travelling here, so I thought I'd need it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然我要在這裡旅行，所以我想我可能需要...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Haha, is that so?
I've heard of the rumour that your race exists, but I've never seen one before.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哈哈，是嗎？
我聽說過你們種族存在的傳聞，但以前從未見過。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
And to think you can speak our language. Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
而且你居然會說我們的語言。真有趣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...but just a moment ago, you were having a hard time with something. Is something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...不過剛才，你好像遇到了什麼困難。出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
It's nothing.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah~ It must be fate that we met~
You can just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~ 看來我們相遇是命中註定的~
你可以直接告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
......
Well...

[Worker]
The screw that is used to keep our tent in place is rusting away... we must get a new one.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
用來固定我們帳篷的螺絲正在生鏽...我們必須換一個新的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
But I can't leave this place, so I was waiting for someone to pass by.
And you just happened to talk to me. I thought you were someone from our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
但我不能離開這裡，所以我在等路人經過。
而你正好和我搭話了。我以為你是我們部落的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can help you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以幫你。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No, it's alright. We just met, so I don't want to trouble you.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不，沒關係。我們才剛認識，我不想麻煩你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry about it! Life is all about helping eachother, don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心！生活就是互相幫助，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
- While the disagreement is taking place, - 
 - The screw that has held its ground til now - 
 - Finally gives in and breaks in half. -
scripts.translation:
- 就在爭執之際，-
- 一直勉強支撐著的螺絲 -
- 終於不堪重負，斷成了兩截。-

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Ah!!!

[Worker]
I can't just care about pride now.
Let me introduce myself, I am ^0000FFGill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
現在不能只顧著面子了。
讓我自我介紹一下，我是^0000FF吉爾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
I need a screw to stablize our tent, and it can be found from the ^0000FFHillslion^000000 monster.
Please help me collect ^0000FF30 Horns of Hillslion^000000, and that should be enough for now.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
我需要螺絲來固定我們的帳篷，可以從^0000FF希斯利安^000000魔物身上獲得。
請幫我收集^0000FF30個希斯利安的鍬形蟲^000000，這樣就夠用了。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
I'm really sorry, so please hurry.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
真的很抱歉，請快點。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
You helped me collect all of the Horns of Hillslion?
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
你幫我收集齊了所有的希斯利安之角？
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
It's all because of you, we are able to prevent anything disastrous.
^0000FFEven though you're also an alien race, but compared to the vile fairies^000000, I'm glad to have met someone like {0}.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
多虧了你，我們才得以避免災難發生。
^0000FF雖然你也是異族，但比起那些邪惡的妖精^000000，我很高興能遇到像{0}這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
Making you do something like this, I feel ashamed.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
讓你做這種事，我感到很慚愧。

scripts.text:
[Gill]
Thank you for helping me.
^0000FFEven though you're also an alien race, but compared to the vile Fairies^000000, I'm glad to have met someone like {0}.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
謝謝你的幫助。
^0000FF雖然你也是外星種族，但比起那些邪惡的妖精^000000，我很高興能遇到像{0}這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
This is too dangerous, it's become too loose...
It must be replaced soon...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這太危險了，已經變得太鬆了...
必須儘快更換...

scripts.text:
[Gill]
You're here again?
Talking with someone occasionally is quite relaxing.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾]
你又來了？
偶爾和人聊聊天還挺放鬆的。

scripts.translation: - 你聽不懂他在說什麼。-

scripts.text:
There's something strange here.
Maybe that device can be controlled from here.
scripts.translation:
這裡有些奇怪。
也許那個裝置可以從這裡控制。

scripts.text: Try to control.
scripts.translation: 嘗試控制

scripts.text: Don't try to control it.
scripts.translation: 不要嘗試控制

scripts.text: You press the device buttons and it suddenly becomes dark.
scripts.translation: 你按下裝置的按鈕，四周突然變得一片漆黑。

scripts.text: You decide to leave it alone.
scripts.translation: 你決定不去碰它。

scripts.text:
The device has already been activated.
You must wait for the controls to reset.
scripts.translation:
裝置已經啟動。
你必須等待控制面板重置。

scripts.text:
There's a controllable device here.
You might be able to control that device from here.
scripts.translation:
這裡有一個可控制的裝置。
也許你可以從這裡控制那個裝置。

scripts.text: Control.
scripts.translation: 控制

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Seems to have been started.
scripts.translation: 似乎已經啟動了。

The device is now on.
Panels have appeared across the ledge.
scripts.translation:
裝置現在已開啟。
邊緣處出現了控制面板。

scripts.text: You decide not to control the device.
scripts.translation: 你決定不控制該裝置。

scripts.translation: 請輸入密碼。

scripts.translation: 要重置控制裝置嗎？
